intent.logline_zh: 深夜便利店内店员独自值班，安静，无配乐。

characters.desc_zh: 30岁左右男性店员，深色制服，在收银台后，全程不说话

invariants.setting_zh: 深夜便利店内，冷白荧光灯，空货架

beats.what_zh: 店员缓慢擦收银台，固定广角
店员停下，望向玻璃门外空街道

risks: 原文“独白”无具体台词，暂按无对白处理；若有词请补，勿把独白写进 soundscape
clarify: “独白”的具体台词是哪一句？补上后可配对口 <d> 或画外音（配“lips remain closed”）。

pe.integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action convenience store interior past midnight, cool fluorescent light over empty aisles. A male clerk in his 30s in a dark uniform slowly wipes the counter, the only person in the store. The camera holds a static wide shot as he pauses and gazes out the glass door at the empty street. One continuous shot with no cuts.
pe.overall_soundscape: Low fluorescent hum and faint traffic beyond the glass, nothing else.
